content.value_statement: Teams need relevant document retrieval for RAG and knowledge bases. This skill guides AgentDB setup, embedding storage, indexing, API search, and relevance tuning.
actual_capabilities: Guides AgentDB initialization with vector dimensions and HNSW indexing.
Shows how to embed documents and store metadata with vectors.
Outlines REST API endpoints for semantic search queries.
Describes metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, and result re-ranking.
Defines success metrics for relevance, latency, and top result quality.
limitations: Requires an available AgentDB package or compatible vector search implementation.
Requires access to an embedding model and related credentials.
Examples need adaptation for authentication, validation, and production deployment.
Does not include full operational guidance for scaling or monitoring.

use_cases.title: Build RAG Retrieval Backend
use_cases.description: Create a vector search layer that returns relevant context for LLM responses.

use_cases.title: Improve Knowledge Base Search
use_cases.description: Add semantic matching so users can find documents by meaning, not exact keywords.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Search Relevance
use_cases.description: Plan retrieval metrics, top result checks, and tuning cycles for search quality.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan an AgentDB semantic search index for my document corpus. Include dimensions, metadata fields, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design Document Ingestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a document ingestion flow with embeddings, metadata storage, and duplicate handling for AgentDB.

prompt_templates.title: Create Search API Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline REST API endpoints for semantic search, filtering, pagination, and result ranking.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Hybrid Retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to improve an existing AgentDB search system with hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and relevance evaluation.

output_examples.input: Plan semantic search for support articles.
output: A five-phase implementation checklist for database setup, ingestion, indexing, API design, and tuning.
Recommended metadata fields for category, title, source, and freshness.
Success metrics for latency, top result quality, and retrieval accuracy.

output_examples.input: Improve weak search results in a knowledge base.
output: A tuning plan that compares vector retrieval, keyword matching, and hybrid weighting.
A re-ranking step for improving final result order.
A validation plan using sample queries and expected relevant documents.
Endpoint responsibilities for search, filtering, and context retrieval.
Guidance for top result limits, metadata filters, and response fields.
Testing criteria for relevance, latency, and reliability.

best_practices: Validate embedding dimensions before storing vectors.
Keep metadata filters simple and aligned with user search needs.
Measure relevance with representative queries before production rollout.
anti_patterns: Do not assume keyword search alone will satisfy semantic retrieval goals.
Do not store document text without clear privacy and retention controls.
Do not tune latency without checking result relevance.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build semantic vector search systems with AgentDB for documents, RAG, and knowledge bases.

faq.question: Does it include a full production service?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and examples that need production hardening.

faq.question: Which users benefit from this skill?
faq.answer: Backend engineers, ML engineers, and product teams building intelligent search can benefit.

faq.question: Does it support hybrid search?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes combining vector search with keyword matching and re-ranking.

faq.question: Do I need an embedding model?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on embeddings from a compatible model or service.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
